name: PB_COLL_PROCESS_TBL
description: The related table for all the collections processes on a PBA.

columns.name: PB_ACCT_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the account record.

columns.name: LINE
columns.description: The line number for the information associated with this record. Multiple pieces of information can be associated with this record.

columns.name: PB_COLL_STAT_C_NAME
columns.description: The status of the collections process. Used to determine system behavior.

columns.name: PB_COLL_STEP_C_NAME
columns.description: The current step of the collections process on the account.

columns.name: PB_IN_COLL_SINCE_DATE
columns.description: Represents the date on which this instance entered the collections process.

columns.name: COLL_PROCESS_NUM
columns.description: The unique ID for the collection process on the account.

columns.name: PB_IN_STAT_SINCE_DATE
columns.description: Represents the date in which this instance entered the current status of the collections process.

columns.name: PB_IN_STEP_SINCE_DATE
columns.description: Represents the date in which this instance entered the current step of the collections process.

columns.name: PB_ORIG_AMT_OUTST_N
columns.description: Stores the total amount outstanding that was originally added to collections.
